What We're Looking For 5–8 years of relevant experience in payroll, HR operations, compensation & benefits, or a similar role. Strong hands-on experience managing Egyptian payroll. Solid knowledge of Egyptian tax and social insurance requirements. Practical experience dealing with tax portals, Social Insurance offices, and government authorities. Experience managing medical insurance administration. Strong understanding of overtime calculations and payroll-related processes. Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Strong Excel skills and confidence working with HR/payroll systems. Ability to handle confidential information with a high level of discretion. Clear communication skills and the confidence to deal with employees, management, Finance, insurance providers, and government authorities. A hands-on, problem-solving mindset—someone who can own the process from start to finish, rather than simply follow instructions. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means that: Payroll is accurate and on time. Overtime is properly controlled and paid. Taxes and social insurance are compliant and up to date. Medical insurance runs smoothly. Employee requests are resolved efficiently. HR operations are organized, documented, and increasingly automated. review_candidates.title: Malayalam Content Creator & Video Editor
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: About Times Square Watches Times Square Watches is a UAE based watch retailer and distributor established in 1990, with more than three decades of experience in the watch industry. Based in Abu Dhabi, we operate across retail, wholesale distribution and e-commerce, offering watches from established international brands as well as brands from our own portfolio. As we continue to grow our digital presence, we are looking for a creative Malayalam-speaking content creator who can help us connect with the Malayalam audience through engaging, personality-driven content. About the Role We are looking for a Malayalam Content Creator & Video Editor who is confident in front of the camera and knows how to turn products and simple ideas into stories people actually want to watch. This is not a role where you will simply receive a script, record it and post it. We want someone who can come up with their own ideas, hooks, concepts and storytelling angles, confidently present them on camera, shoot the content and turn the footage into polished short form videos. The content will primarily be created for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok and other short-form social platforms, targeting the Malayalam-speaking audience in the UAE and beyond. Key Responsibilities * Create engaging Malayalam short form video content * Present confidently and naturally in front of the camera * Develop creative concepts, hooks and storytelling ideas * Write or contribute to scripts and content structures * Shoot product, lifestyle, talking head and promotional content * Edit videos from start to finish * Use B-roll, close ups, subtitles, transitions, music and sound effectively * Create content that promotes products without making every video feel like a traditional advertisement * Follow relevant social media trends and adapt them to the brand * Experiment with different formats to improve views, engagement and audience retention * Work closely with the team to plan upcoming campaigns, products and launches * Maintain a consistent content style and brand identity Qualifications * Fluent Malayalam speaking ability is essential * Strong communication and storytelling skills * Confident and comfortable appearing on camera * Good video editing skills * Understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok and short-form video * Ability to shoot good quality content using a smartphone or camera * Good understanding of hooks, pacing and audience retention * Creative mindset with the ability to generate original ideas * Able to work independently rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every video * Based in Abu Dhabi or able to work regularly from Abu Dhabi Preferred Skills Experience with tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar editing software would be an advantage. Previous experience creating Malayalam social-media content, product videos, lifestyle content, storytelling videos or personal-brand content would also be highly valued. Knowledge of watches is not mandatory. What matters more is your ability to understand a product and find an interesting way to tell its story. What We’re Really Looking For We care more about your creativity, personality and actual content than an impressive CV. You should be someone who can look at a product and think: “How can I turn this into a video people will stop scrolling to watch?” If you enjoy experimenting with ideas, speaking to an audience and bringing stories to life through video, we’d like to hear from you. How to Apply Please submit: * Your CV or a short introduction * Links to 2–3 videos/Reels you have created * Your Instagram, TikTok or portfolio, if available * Any Malayalam content you have previously created Applicants may also be asked to complete a short content or camera test as part of the selection process.
